content:
On 15 December, at the Alfândega do Porto, the conference “Strategy for a Sustainable Future for Construction” will take place. This conference is being organised by BUILT CoLAB under the FoC – Future of Construction* project and aims to discuss key aspects for the future of the construction sector: Digitalisation, Innovation, Sustainability and Professional Qualification.

Contributing to this debate will be the results of studies on these topics carried out by the consultancies Deloitte, Fi Group, 3drivers and EY, followed by a round table between representatives of entities relevant to the sector, under the theme “The Future of Construction: from Digitalisation to Professional Qualification”.

This round table aims to reflect on the main challenges Construction is currently facing, from the labour shortage, to rising construction prices, to sustainability/circularity targets, and how digitalisation plays a central role in responding to these challenges. This session will feature Carlos Mineiro Aires, Chair of the Conselho Superior de Obras Públicas, Ana Paula Santos, Vice-Chair of the Ordem dos Arquitetos, Ricardo Gomes, Vice-Chair of AICCOPN, and Nandin de Carvalho, Chair of the Associação Portuguesa de Projetistas e Consultores, moderated by António Larguesa, journalist at Jornal Digital ECO.

The event will take place from 2:30pm in the Salão Nobre of the Alfândega do Porto. It is free of charge, but registration is required here, with participation limited to the room's capacity.

The full programme will be announced shortly.

* FoC – Future of Construction is a SIAC – Collective Actions Support System project, co-financed by COMPETE 2020, through Portugal 2020 and the European Regional Development Fund, led by BUILT CoLAB, which aims to define the strategy for the Twin Transition of the AEC sector, based on four structural pillars: Digitalise, Transform, Preserve and Qualify. To this end, it intends to implement a structured action plan that promotes digital transformation, carbon neutrality, the circular economy, innovation and the qualification and certification of skills. This conference is the project's final event, presenting the main results achieved.

More information about this project is available on the website at https://futureofconstruction.pt/.
